title: 世界のファッションウィークカレンダー

events.name: Copenhagen Fashion Week (AW27)
events.acc: AW27 dates are confirmed on the official schedule page (copenhagenfashionweek.com/schedule: "AW27 / 1 – 5 February 2027"); re-confirmed 2026.9.19. The SS27 edition (2026.8.3〜7) has already taken place. No AW27 accreditation window has been announced yet — the former application/accreditation-form URL now returns a 404; the application index page (copenhagenfashionweek.com/application) currently lists only "Show & Presentation Application" and "Event & Talk Application", no accreditation link. Contact: info@copenhagenfashionweek.com

events.name: Rakuten Fashion Week TOKYO 2027 A/W
events.acc: The 2027 S/S edition (2026.8.31〜9.5, Shibuya Hikarie) has concluded. The next edition, Rakuten Fashion Week TOKYO 2027 A/W, is confirmed for 2027.3.15〜20 per the official site ("2027AW MON. 03/15– SAT. 03/20/2027"). Registration for 2027 A/W is not yet open — the registration page still only states "Registration for press, photographers and buyers for Rakuten Fashion Week TOKYO 2027 S/S is now closed" (deadline was 2026.7.29 18:00 JST); re-confirmed 2026.9.19. Contact: press/photographer jfwpress@jfw.jp, buyer buyer@jfw.jp

events.name: Dubai Fashion Week (SS27)
events.acc: Dubai Fashion Week SS27 is confirmed for 2026.10.22〜26 at Dubai Design District (d3), per the official about page ("SS27 — 22 – 26 October 2026"); the homepage states the official SS27 calendar goes live 2026.10.1 (the /calendar/ page still shows the past AW26/27 edition). Re-checked 2026.9.19: /registration/, /press-accreditation/, /buyers-registration/ and /photographers-application/ are all live but show no season-specific status or dates — the homepage's "DESIGNER'S APPLICATION OPEN FOR SEPTEMBER 2026 – SS27" banner refers to designer show applications, not press/buyer/photographer accreditation. Accreditation open/closed status remains unconfirmed. Contact press@arabfashioncouncil.com / buyers@arabfashioncouncil.com.

events.name: Seoul Fashion Week (2027 F/W, est.)
events.ref: Ref: the 2027 S/S edition (this entry) ran 2026.9.1〜6 at DDP and other venues; the prior F/W edition (2026 F/W) ran 2026.2.3〜8, concentrated at DDP
events.reason: The 2027 S/S edition has concluded (ended 2026.9.6) with no second-round press/photographer accreditation call announced. The next edition, 2027 F/W, has not yet been officially announced on seoulfashionweek.org as of 2026.9.19; the registration page (seoulfashionweek.org/hmpg/fawk/regi/regiMain.do) still only shows the closed 2027 S/S PRESS period (2026.7.31〜8.15) with no 2027 F/W section published. The estimate is based on the 2026 F/W timing (early February). Contact sfwinfo@seoul.go.kr

events.name: New York Fashion Week (Fall 2027, est.)
events.est: Est. 2027.2 (early–mid, dates not yet officially announced)
events.ref: Ref: the Spring 2027 edition (this entry) ran 2026.9.10〜15
events.reason: The Spring 2027 edition has concluded (ended 2026.9.15). CFDA has not yet announced dates for the next edition; cfda.com/events and nyfw.com/schedule show no February 2027 listing as of 2026.9.19 (CFDA typically only publishes a preliminary schedule 4–6 weeks ahead of the season). Per CFDA's naming convention, the February season is termed "Fall/Winter" ("Fall 2027"). NYFW runs no centralized press accreditation — each designer handles media individually (nyfw.com/press states "NYFW: The Shows will not be credentialing media").

events.name: London Fashion Week (SS27)
events.acc: The British Fashion Council (BFC) confirms LFW runs Thursday 17th to Monday 21st September 2026 (re-confirmed 2026.9.19, event now underway). The accreditation page (londonfashionweek.co.uk/accreditation) and criteria page (press must show published work within 12 months; buyer, photographer, stylist and showroom criteria also listed) are live, but no opening/closing dates or explicit open/closed status are stated on the page text — still unconfirmed.

events.name: Milano Fashion Week (SS27)
events.acc: Press accreditation closed — cameramoda.it's press accreditation page (and its Italian version) states the deadline for submitting required documentation was Tuesday 2026.9.15 ("il termine ultimo", i.e. the final deadline); re-checked 2026.9.19, four days after the deadline, with no second-round call or "now closed" banner but also no sign of continued processing. The women's SS27 calendar remains confirmed on cameramoda.it: "Spring/Summer 2027 | 22nd - 28th September 2026."

events.name: Paris Fashion Week (SS27, Womenswear)
events.acc: SS27 (Womenswear) accreditation remains open — fhcm.paris states "Accreditations for the Womenswear Paris Fashion Week® Spring/Summer 2027 are now open !" (accreditation.fhcm.paris/en; no deadline posted; re-confirmed 2026.9.19). Contact accreditation@fhcm.paris. Provisional calendar: 101 labels, 68 runway shows, 33 presentations; Julie Kegels opens 9.28, Louis Vuitton closes 10.6.

events.name: Taipei Fashion Week (SS27)
events.acc: Venue = Kong Zong Cultural Base (C-LAB): Heritage Square for runway shows, 2F for presentations, 1F for the trade show. Buyer applications deadline 9.7 has passed. The schedule page is now live with dated programming (tpefw.com/en/schedules, Runway/Trade Show/Fashion Salon sessions 10.16〜17), but press/photographer accreditation is still not published — top navigation lists only Brand Show, Trade Show, Event and Buyer, with no Press/Media category; /en/press returns 404 (re-confirmed 2026.9.19). tpefw-reg.tw renders as an empty JS shell for press-related URLs, so a dedicated portal could not be confirmed either way.

events.name: Berlin Fashion Week (AW27)
events.acc: AW27 dates (2027.1.29〜2.1) confirmed via the site header and official-schedule page banner (re-confirmed 2026.9.19). The accreditation page (fashionweek.berlin/en/calendar/bfw-accreditation.html) is still titled "Accreditation SS27" and states "Accreditation for Berlin Fashion Week is now closed. Please contact the organisers and designers directly" — this refers to the past SS27 window; no AW27-specific accreditation window has been announced. (A separate designer-facing "Concept Competition AW2027" open call, deadline 2026.10.5, is unrelated to press accreditation.)

events.name: China Fashion Week Beijing (Spring 2027, est.)
events.ref: Ref: the prior Spring 2026 edition ran 2026.3.20〜28; the Autumn 2026 edition (this entry) ran 2026.9.3〜10
events.reason: The Autumn 2026 edition has concluded (ended 2026.9.10). The official site (english.chinafashionweek.org.cn) still lists "2026 AUTUMN" as its latest season and has not yet announced dates for the next (Spring 2027) edition as of 2026.9.19; the estimate is based on the Spring 2026 timing (mid-to-late March). No online press/accreditation page is published — the Press Center lists only a phone/fax contact (010-84562288 / fax 010-64387099).

events.name: Shanghai Fashion Week (SS2027, est.)
events.reason: Official schedule page (shanghaifashionweek.com/page/shfw/schedule) still lists only AW2026 (3.25〜4.12, ended); SS2027 dates not yet posted (re-checked 2026.9.19). Note: a widely-circulated "10.9" date online actually refers to the prior SS2026 season (announced in 2025 per Shanghai municipal government coverage), not SS2027 — disregarded as stale/misattributed.

events.name: Shenzhen Fashion Week (Autumn 2026, est.)
events.ref: Officially held twice a year (spring / autumn)
events.reason: Next dates unconfirmed — the official site (szfashionweek.com) remains unreachable (DNS lookup failure, re-confirmed 2026.9.19). The organiser (Shenzhen Garment Industry Association) may still be active — its S/S 2025 edition was covered by Shenzhen government-affiliated media in 2024 — but no 2026 edition news could be found and formal discontinuation is unconfirmed either way. This is a distinct event from "Shenzhen Original Design Fashion Week" (tracked separately under Fashion Source Shenzhen), which has its own separate lineage.

events.name: Shenzhen Original Design Fashion Week / Fashion Source (SS27, 2026.10)
events.est: 2026.10.21〜23 (33rd Fashion Source Shenzhen, concurrent with SS27 Shenzhen Original Design Fashion Week; confirmed on official site, re-checked 2026.9.19)
events.ref: Ref: the prior edition ran 2026.4.15〜17 (Shenzhen Convention & Exhibition Center)
events.reason: Re-confirmed on the official Fashion Source Shenzhen site (homepage banner: "FS 2026 Autumn registration is open — see you in Shenzhen this October"): dates 2026.10.21〜23 (Shenzhen Convention & Exhibition Center, Futian), re-checked 2026.9.19. Visitor registration and booth booking are open; the site's Media Center / Media Contact pages list only partner-media logos and a generic contact (info@fashionsource.cn, tel. 0755-8254-2710) — no dedicated press accreditation form or deadline published yet.

events.name: Riyadh Fashion Week (2026, est.)
events.est: Reported (not yet confirmed on official channels): 2026.10.15〜20, per press coverage citing the Saudi Fashion Commission
events.ref: Ref: the 3rd edition (2025) ran 10.16〜21 (announced on official Instagram)
events.reason: The official site and Instagram remain unreachable as of 2026.9.19 (site: connection refused; Saudi Fashion Commission's cultural-calendar page also failed to load despite appearing in search results). Press coverage is inconsistent: several outlets (Time Out Riyadh, WWD, FashionNetwork, Harper's Bazaar Arabia) report the 4th edition for 2026.10.15〜20 citing the Saudi Fashion Commission, while another article describing the 2025 (3rd) edition cites 2026.10.16〜21 for that separate past edition — no primary Saudi Fashion Commission statement could be located to directly confirm the 2026 dates. Dates are treated as press-reported, not officially confirmed.

events.name: Shibuya Fashion Week (2026 Autumn)
events.acc: The official site now confirms the 26th edition, "SFW 2026 Autumn," held Sunday 2026.10.18 (venue: "Somewhere in Shibuya", details TBA); confirmed 2026.9.19. Held twice a year (spring / autumn); the Spring 2026 edition ("CULTIVATE") ran 2026.3.13〜22. No press/media accreditation portal is live yet — the /register page still returns a 404; /contact/ has only a generic press-inquiry contact form.
